packet_exact_target: im(H_{16}(hat{partial} Mbar_{6,6};Q) -> H_{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q)) is a finite direct sum of Q(8)
goal: Prove that the image of the degree-16 boundary map of Mbar_{6,6} is Tate of type Q(8), or exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in that image.

paired_attempt_policy.exact_theorem: The image of the boundary map H_{16}(hat{partial} Mbar_{6,6};Q) -> H_{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) from the normalization of the boundary of the moduli stack of stable 6-pointed genus-6 curves is a finite direct sum of Q(8). Equivalently this image is a pure polarizable Tate Hodge structure of weight -16 and type Q(8). A disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this image. This theorem does not re-prove the open residual W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), and does not by itself conclude H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) cong Q(-8)^{oplus b_16}.

bottleneck.title: Non-separating boundary divisor

fields.label: Complementary cokernel
fields.value: The cokernel is the C66-001 open residual, double-confirmed as ATT-0136; this campaign does not re-prove it

fields.label: Non-separating normalization
fields.value: [Mbar_{5,8}/S_2], where S_2 exchanges the two branches of the node; its ordered atlas Mbar_{5,8} is the unique RED-0001 residual pair in the boundary of Mbar_{6,6}

fields.label: Separating type
fields.value: Quotients [Mbar_Gamma/Aut(Gamma)] for one-edge separating graphs, with ordered atlas Mbar_{g1,n1} x Mbar_{g2,n2}, g1+g2=6 and n1+n2=8; cohomology is taken with Aut(Gamma)-invariants and the determinant-edge convention

program: Identify every component of hat{partial} Mbar_{6,6} as [Mbar_Gamma/Aut(Gamma)], including [Mbar_{5,8}/S_2] for the non-separating graph, and retain the determinant-edge convention.
Discharge every separating H^{16} Kunneth term from published even cohomology through degree 14 and CKgP/induction on non-residual factors.
Prove the open residual of (5,8) by the same CLP Lemma 3.1 + Harer + CKgP peel as ATT-0136, at n-1=c(5)=7 and ordinary degree 24.
Check that the boundary of Mbar_{5,8} is outside RED-0001, assemble compact H^{16}(Mbar_{5,8}) by THM-0003, and conclude that the (6,6) boundary-image is Tate.

subproblems.title: Identify the normalized boundary of Mbar_{6,6}
subproblems.exact_theorem: Let Xbar := Mbar_{6,6} be the moduli stack of stable genus-6 curves with 6 ordered marked points, and let hat{partial} Xbar be the normalization of its reduced boundary divisor. Prove all of the following, with no Tate assertion. (i) The non-separating component has normalization [Mbar_{5,8}/S_2], where S_2 exchanges the two ordered preimages of the node. (ii) For every one-edge separating stable graph Gamma, the corresponding normalized component is [Mbar_Gamma/Aut(Gamma)], where Mbar_Gamma=Mbar_{g1,n1} x Mbar_{g2,n2}, g1+g2=6, n1+n2=8, and both vertices are stable. (iii) Its contribution is (H^*(Mbar_Gamma) tensor det E_Gamma)^{Aut(Gamma)}. This theorem names the source of the campaign boundary map and does not assert Tate type of any cohomology group.

subproblems.title: Discharge the open residual of (5,8)
subproblems.exact_theorem: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{5,8};Q), equivalently W_{24}H^{24}(M_{5,8};Q)(20), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group. This theorem does not conclude H^{16}(Mbar_{5,8};Q) and does not conclude the campaign boundary-image theorem.

subproblems.title: Show the boundary of Mbar_{5,8} lies outside RED-0001
subproblems.exact_theorem: Every factor occurring in the normalization of an irreducible boundary divisor of Mbar_{5,8} lies outside the RED-0001 residual list. The non-separating component is [Mbar_{4,10}/S_2]. A separating one-edge graph has ordered atlas Mbar_{g1,n1} x Mbar_{g2,n2} with g1+g2=5, n1+n2=10, and both vertices stable, modulo Aut(Gamma). In particular a genus-5 factor has at most 7 markings and a genus-3 factor has at most 9 markings, so no factor is one of (3,12), (5,8), (6,6), (7,4), (8,0), (8,1), or (8,2). This theorem makes no Tate assertion and does not conclude H^{16}(Mbar_{5,8};Q).

subproblems.title: Type the separating Kunneth terms of H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6})
subproblems.exact_theorem: Using a verified C66BAR-GRAPH identification of the one-edge separating components [Mbar_Gamma/Aut(Gamma)], prove that every Aut(Gamma)-invariant determinant-edge Kunneth summand in degree 16 is a finite direct sum of Q(-8). On the ordered product atlases, the only degree-16 factors that arise have n<=7 and lie outside RED-0001; even degrees <=14 are in the published tautological range. This theorem does not treat the non-separating component [Mbar_{5,8}/S_2] and does not conclude the campaign boundary-image theorem.

subproblems.title: Assemble compact H^{16}(Mbar_{5,8}) from its open residual
subproblems.exact_theorem: Using a verified C58-OPEN residual and a verified C58-BOUNDARY accounting, apply the boundary right-exact sequence of THM-0003 to conclude that H^{16}(Mbar_{5,8};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(-8). A disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this compact group. This theorem does not conclude the campaign boundary-image theorem.

This theorem does not re-prove the open residual W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), and does not by itself conclude H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) cong Q(-8)^{oplus b_16}.
